code:
aws ec2 create-security-group \
  --group-name web-sg \
  --description "Web tier" \
  --vpc-id vpc-0abc123456789def0

aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress \
  --group-id sg-0abc123456789def0 \
  --protocol tcp --port 443 \
  --cidr 0.0.0.0/0
caption: Default: no inbound rules, one default outbound rule allowing everything — and return traffic is automatic.

code:
aws ec2 create-network-acl-entry \
  --network-acl-id acl-0abc123456789def0 \
  --no-egress \
  --rule-number 100 --protocol tcp \
  --port-range From=443,To=443 \
  --cidr-block 0.0.0.0/0 --rule-action allow
caption: Rule numbers are evaluated lowest-first, and the first match — allow or deny — wins.
